literal_meaning: নাক এবং মুখে কথা (words appearing on the nose and face)
similar_in_english: wear one's heart on one's sleeve
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নাকেমুখে কথা লেখা, কিছু লুকাতে পারে না।
বাচাল লোকের নাকেমুখে কথা ফুটে ওঠে।
example_sentences_in_english: His words are written on his nose and face; he can't hide anything.
A talkative person's words show on their face.
note: This idiom emphasizes inability to conceal thoughts or emotions, common in Bengali oral tradition.
